text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the spring Tenno Sho arrives. Among the competitors is Mejiro McQueen, set on winning the race for the third consecutive year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower heads to the starting gates of this grand race, hoping to make a miracle happen.
